answer: Routing Diversity Requirement. Each agent must maintain at least k distinct multi-hop paths to unrelated peers, verified by signed latency probes. A voyage of a probe records relay diversity; a prism splits the route set so no single node dominates. New identities cannot bridge into existing clusters without distinct, independently measured paths. An attacker must sustain k real relays per identity, multiplying infrastructure and latency cost linearly per fake node.
